review_scope: Independent read-only review of the M1610 compact decoder L0/L1 source, tests and contract. Static and synthetic execution only.

notes: M1610 is a representation-only implementation of the frozen M1539 request scheduler and nine-entry cache through synthetic L1; it is not yet an actual decoder generator or result producer.
The packed address and packed commit digests are exact against the M1539 row adapter; they intentionally do not masquerade as the legacy JSON transaction digest.

The 129-slot array is a static capacity proof; the synthetic service model can physically fill the external queue to 16 entries, while other queues remain constrained by their port initiation intervals and latencies.

single_next_authorization.authorized: Author a separately named L2 canonical-prefix source and contract that binds this exact M1610 source and preserves all intervening cache/calendar history.
not_authorized: opening or executing the actual ep34 payload under M1615
single_next_authorization.execution_gate: The L2 source must receive a new independent review before any actual-prefix execution. L3 remains separately gated.
